skills.name: mb-signal-retail
skills.description: 零售行业环境信号包（谦面·生意体检姊妹件，需与内核套件 mb-core 叠加安装）。读四类信号：批发价参考（昆明花拍日度价，花店/生鲜进货直接参考）、城市基本面（中国城市面板 209 变量×297 城，判断社区消费力与选址）、同业密度（工商登记区县+行业小类，可筛个体工商户）、快递大盘景气（邮政局月报，兼营电商参考）。工商数据最新批次 2023、滞后约 3 年，一律标注「历史格局、非实时」；无注销口径，「关了多少家」明示做不了并给存量状态分布替代，禁止编造关店量。

canonical.brief: Catering industry environmental signal pack (install alongside the Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite): food-cost trend (Dalian Commodity Exchange futures — live hogs/soybean meal/corn/palm oil — trend warnings for catering's largest variable-cost item, not market spot prices), a commercial-distric

zh-CN.name: 生意体检 · 餐饮信号包
zh-CN.summary: 餐饮行业环境信号包（需与「生意体检 · 内核套件」叠加安装）：食材成本趋势（大连商品交易所期货：生猪/豆粕/玉米/棕榈油，餐饮最大变动成本项的趋势预警，不等于菜市场现货价）、商圈活跃度代理（专资办电影票房日榜/周榜，2017 起可回溯，反映商圈消费活跃度而非本店客流）、堂食外卖切换代理（中央气象台天气，34 省 2529 站时级，结构性提示而非客流预测），并可选查同业密度（工商登记区县 + 行业小类）。每个信号均标注代理性质与局限；信号源不可用时标注「未连接」且不填模型记忆值。工商类信号带批次年份与「历史格局、非实时」标注，且明示无注销/吊销口径、不做关店量。

en.name: Micro-Business · Catering Signal Pack
en.summary: Catering industry environmental signal pack (install alongside the Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite): food-cost trend (Dalian Commodity Exchange futures — live hogs/soybean meal/corn/palm oil — trend warnings for catering's largest variable-cost item, not market spot prices), a commercial-district activity proxy (national film box office daily/weekly charts, traceable back to 2017; reflects district consumption activity, not your store's footfall), and a dine-in/delivery shift proxy (Central Meteorological Observatory weather, hourly across 34 provinces and 2,529 stations; a structural hint, not a footfall forecast), plus optional peer-density lookup (business registry at county + sub-industry granularity). Every signal is labeled with its proxy nature and its limits; when a source is unavailable it is marked 'not connected' and never filled with model-memory values. Registry-based signals carry their batch year with a 'historical snapshot, not real-time' label, and explicitly state that there is no deregistration/revocation scope and no closure counts.

es.name: Micro-Business · Pack de señales de restauración
es.summary: Paquete de señales ambientales del sector restauración (instalar junto al Micro-Business · Suite de chequeo central): tendencia de costes de alimentos (futuros de la Bolsa de Mercancías de Dalian —cerdo vivo/harina de soja/maíz/aceite de palma—, alertas de tendencia sobre la mayor partida de coste variable de la restauración; no son precios spot de mercado), proxy de actividad de la zona comercial (listas diarias/semanales de taquilla cinematográfica, rastreables desde 2017; refleja la actividad de consumo de la zona, no la clientela de tu tienda) y proxy de cambio entre servicio en local y a domicilio (tiempo del Observatorio Meteorológico Central, horario, 34 provincias y 2529 estaciones; una indicación estructural, no una previsión de clientela), más consulta opcional de densidad de competencia (registro mercantil con granularidad de distrito + subcategoría sectorial). Cada señal indica su carácter de proxy y sus límites; si la fuente no está disponible se marca «no conectado» y nunca se rellena con valores de memoria del modelo. Las señales del registro llevan año de lote con la marca «panorama histórico, no en tiempo real», y declaran explícitamente que no hay cómputo de bajas/revocaciones ni cifras de cierres.

fr.name: Micro-Business · Pack de signaux pour la restauration
fr.summary: Pack de signaux environnementaux pour la restauration (à installer en complément du Micro-Business · Suite de diagnostic de base) : tendance des coûts des denrées (futurs de la Bourse des marchandises de Dalian — porcs vivants/tourteau de soja/maïs/huile de palme — alertes de tendance sur le plus gros poste de coûts variables de la restauration, pas des prix au comptant de marché), proxy d'activité de la zone commerciale (palmarès quotidiens/hebdomadaires du box-office cinématographique, rétroactifs depuis 2017 ; reflète l'activité de consommation du quartier, pas le passage dans votre boutique) et proxy de bascule entre sur place et livraison (météo de l'Observatoire météorologique central, à l'heure, 34 provinces et 2 529 stations ; une indication structurelle, pas une prévision de fréquentation), plus consultation optionnelle de la densité concurrentielle (registre du commerce à la granularité district + sous-branche). Chaque signal est annoté de sa nature de proxy et de ses limites ; si la source est indisponible il est marqué « non connecté » et jamais rempli de valeurs sorties de la mémoire du modèle. Les signaux issus du registre portent l'année de lot avec la mention « panorama historique, pas en temps réel », et indiquent explicitement l'absence de périmètre de radiations/retraits et l'absence de chiffres de fermetures.

ja.name: Micro-Business · 飲食シグナルパック
ja.summary: 飲食業の環境シグナルパック（「Micro-Business · コア診断スイート」との併設が必要）：食材コスト傾向（大連商品交易所先物：生豚/大豆ミール/トウモロコシ/パーム油。飲食業最大の変動費項目のトレンド警報で、市場のスポット価格ではない）、商圏の賑わいプロキシ（映画興行収入の日次/週次ランキング、2017年以降に遡及可能。商圏の消費活性を反映し、自店の来客数ではない）、イートイン/デリバリー切替プロキシ（中央気象台の天気、34省2529地点の時間粒度。構造的なヒントであって来客予測ではない）、加えて同業密度の照会（任意：商業登記の区県＋業界小類）。各シグナルにはプロキシ性質と限界を必ず注記。シグナルソースが使えない場合は「未接続」と表示し、モデル記憶の値で埋めません。登記系シグナルにはバッチ年と「履歴スナップショット、非リアルタイム」を付け、註銷/取消の集計範囲がなく閉店数は出せないことを明示します。

canonical.brief: Operating-checkup core for China's micro-enterprises and sole proprietors: a four-stage workflow (intake interview → single-store accounting → industry-signal comparison → action list) as the entry skill, with three companion calculators for break-even, gross-margin structure, and cash flow/payment

zh-CN.name: 生意体检 · 内核套件
zh-CN.summary: 面向中国传统微型企业与个体户的经营体检内核：四段式工作流（问诊建档 → 单店算账 → 行业信号对照 → 行动清单）为入口技能，配套盈亏平衡、毛利结构、现金流账期三个计算器。所有金额与比率一律经计算器产出并附计算公式 + 输入基数 + 来源（来源名/地区/年份/口径时间），外部统计基数取不到时该项中止并明示「基数数据源未连接/未定码」，禁止用模型记忆的行业数字填充。未安装行业信号包时如实标注「未安装行业信号包」且不中断分析。单店生意档案可建立在 DAAS 实体模型上（一家店=一个实体，指标持久化 + 告警规则）。内核按小老板能听懂的标准书写，专业术语附日常解释；机构与政务渠道共用同一内核，仅外壳与推送方式不同。

en.name: Micro-Business · Core Checkup Suite
en.summary: Operating-checkup core for China's micro-enterprises and sole proprietors: a four-stage workflow (intake interview → single-store accounting → industry-signal comparison → action list) as the entry skill, with three companion calculators for break-even, gross-margin structure, and cash flow/payment terms. Every amount and ratio is produced by a calculator and carries its formula, input base, and source (source name/region/year/as-of date); when an external statistical base cannot be fetched, that item halts with an explicit 'base data source not connected/uncoded' notice, and filling gaps from the model's memory of industry figures is forbidden. When no industry signal pack is installed, this is honestly labeled and the analysis continues. Single-store business profiles can be persisted on the DAAS entity model (one store = one entity, with persistent indicators and alert rules). The core is written so small-business owners can understand it, with plain-language explanations for technical terms; institutional and government channels share the same core and differ only in shell and delivery.

es.name: Micro-Business · Suite de chequeo central
es.summary: Núcleo de chequeo operativo para microempresas y negocios unipersonales de China: un flujo de cuatro etapas (entrevista de diagnóstico → cuentas de la tienda → contraste con señales del sector → lista de acciones) como habilidad de entrada, con tres calculadoras acompañantes: punto de equilibrio, estructura de margen bruto y flujo de caja/plazos de pago. Todo importe y ratio se produce con una calculadora y lleva fórmula de cálculo, base de entrada y fuente (nombre de la fuente/región/año/corte temporal); si no se puede obtener una base estadística externa, el ítem se detiene e indica explícitamente «fuente de datos base no conectada/sin código», y está prohibido rellenar con cifras sectoriales memorizadas por el modelo. Sin paquete de señales sectoriales instalado, se declara honestamente y el análisis no se interrumpe. El perfil de cada tienda puede persistirse en el modelo de entidades DAAS (una tienda = una entidad, con indicadores persistentes y reglas de alerta). El núcleo se redacta para que el pequeño comerciante lo entienda, con explicaciones cotidianas de los términos técnicos; los canales institucionales y gubernamentales comparten el mismo núcleo y solo cambian la envoltura y el modo de entrega.

fr.name: Micro-Business · Suite de diagnostic de base
fr.summary: Noyau de diagnostic opérationnel pour les micro-entreprises et travailleurs indépendants de Chine : un flux en quatre étapes (entretien de diagnostic → comptes du magasin → confrontation aux signaux sectoriels → liste d'actions) comme compétence d'entrée, avec trois calculatrices compagnes : seuil de rentabilité, structure de marge brute et trésorerie/délais de paiement. Tout montant et tout ratio sortent d'une calculatrice et portent leur formule, leur base d'entrée et leur source (nom de la source/région/année/date de référence) ; si une base statistique externe est introuvable, l'item s'arrête en signalant explicitement « source de données de base non connectée/non codée », et il est interdit de combler avec des chiffres sectoriels sortis de la mémoire du modèle. Sans pack de signaux sectoriels installé, cela est déclaré honnêtement et l'analyse continue. La fiche de chaque magasin peut être persistée sur le modèle d'entités DAAS (un magasin = une entité, avec indicateurs persistants et règles d'alerte). Le noyau est rédigé pour être compris des petits patrons, avec des explications en langage courant pour chaque terme technique ; les canaux institutionnels et gouvernementaux partagent le même noyau, seuls l'habillage et le mode de diffusion changent.

ja.name: Micro-Business · コア診断スイート
ja.summary: 中国の零細企業・個人事業主向けの経営診断コア：四段ワークフロー（ヒアリング記録 → 単店の損益計算 → 業界シグナル対照 → アクションリスト）を入口スキルとし、損益分岐点・粗利構造・キャッシュフロー/支払サイトの3つの計算機を同梱。金額と比率はすべて計算機が算出し、計算式・入力値・出典（ソース名/地域/年/基準時点）を必ず添付します。外部統計の基礎値が取得できない場合はその項目を中止し「基礎データソース未接続/未コード化」を明示、モデル記憶による業界数値の埋め合わせは禁止です。業界シグナルパック未導入時はその旨を正直に表示し、分析は中断しません。単一店舗の経営プロフィールは DAAS エンティティモデル上に永続化できます（1店=1エンティティ、指標の永続化＋アラートルール）。コアは小さなオーナーに伝わる言葉で書かれ、専門用語には平易な解説を付けます。法人・行政の各チャネルも同一コアを使い、外装と配信方法のみが異なります。

en.name: Lex · Labor Law Suite
en.summary: Full labor-dispute workflow plus two calculators (Lex × Wire convergence): labor arbitration end to end (application / defense / evidence list / finality test / deadline table, with an adjudicator branch) as the entry skill, plus the labor-compensation and personal-injury calculators as atomic skills. Legal basis via Lex article-level citation parsing and validity checks; statistical bases via Wire province-year statistics with mandatory provenance (formula + base source + year); computation halts if the statistics source is unavailable or the concept code unset.

es.name: Lex · Suite de derecho laboral
es.summary: Flujo completo de conflictos laborales + dos calculadoras (convergencia Lex × Wire): el arbitraje laboral completo (solicitud / contestación / pruebas / laudo único / plazos, con rama de árbitro) como entrada, más las calculadoras de indemnización laboral y de daño personal como atómicas. Base jurídica vía análisis de citas por artículo de Lex y vigencia verificada; bases estadísticas vía estadísticas Wire por provincia y año con provenance obligatoria (fórmula + fuente de la base + año); el cálculo se detiene si falta la fuente estadística o el código de concepto.

fr.name: Lex · Suite de droit du travail
fr.summary: Parcours complet des conflits du travail + deux calculateurs (convergence Lex × Wire) : l'arbitrage du travail complet (requête / défense / liste des pièces / test de sentence définitive / tableau des délais, avec branche juge) en entrée, plus les calculateurs d'indemnité de rupture et de préjudice corporel en compétences atomiques. Fondement juridique via l'analyse article par article de Lex et validité vérifiée ; bases statistiques via les statistiques Wire par province et par an avec provenance obligatoire (formule + source + année) ; calcul interrompu si la source statistique manque ou le code de concept n'est pas défini.

ja.name: Lex · 労働法スイート

canonical.brief: The pack-forging workshop for ecosystem creators: turn an idea into an installable pack. 1) Forge — discover the platform's MCP tools and skills, check for duplicates, assemble the manifest, pre-validate, publish. 2) Adapt — license review and attribution when building on open-source or external ski

en.name: Facet Forge
en.summary: The pack-forging workshop for ecosystem creators: turn an idea into an installable pack. 1) Forge — discover the platform's MCP tools and skills, check for duplicates, assemble the manifest, pre-validate, publish. 2) Adapt — license review and attribution when building on open-source or external skills, with fallback paths and no-fabrication constraints. 3) Accept — post-publish self-check: does it install, are tools really called, honest when data is missing. Publishing requires creator status.

es.name: Forja de Facet
es.summary: Taller de forja de packs para creadores del ecosistema: convierte una idea en un pack instalable. 1) Forjar — descubre herramientas MCP y habilidades, comprueba duplicados, arma el manifest, prevalida y publica. 2) Adaptar — licencias y atribución al basarse en habilidades de código abierto o externas, con degradación honesta y sin inventar. 3) Aceptar — autochequeo tras publicar: ¿se instala?, ¿las herramientas se invocan de verdad?, ¿es honesto si faltan datos? Publicar exige condición de creador.

fr.name: La Forge Facet
fr.summary: Atelier de forge à packs pour les créateurs de l'écosystème : transformer une idée en pack installable. 1) Forger — découvrir les outils MCP et compétences, vérifier les doublons, assembler le manifest, prévalider, publier. 2) Adapter — licence et attribution quand on part de compétences open source ou externes, avec repli honnête. 3) Réceptionner — autocontrôle après publication : installation, appels réels des outils, honnêteté si les données manquent. Publier exige le statut créateur.

ja.name: Facet フォージ
ja.summary: エコシステムクリエイターのための鋳包工房：アイデアをインストール可能な機能セット（pack）に仕上げます。①鋳造 — プラットフォームで使える MCP ツールとスキルを探索し、重複を確認し、manifest を組み立て、事前検証を経て公開。②改変 — オープンソースや外部スキルを下敷きにするときのライセンス判定と帰属表示（フォールバック経路と捏造禁止の制約つき）。③検収 — 公開後のセルフチェック：インストールできるか、ツールは本当に呼ばれたか、取れないときに誠実か。エコシステムクリエイター向け。公開にはクリエイター資格が必要です。

skills.name: macro-cycle-analysis
skills.description: 宏观周期与景气分析。当用户要求判断当前经济周期位置（复苏/过热/滞胀/衰退）、做六域景气扫描（增长/通胀/货币信用/财政/外贸/地产消费）、做领先-同步-滞后指标分层、识别景气拐点、梳理宏观变量到其业务问题的传导链，或做省际补充与国际对比时使用。走柏讯服务端宏观数据，不含收益率曲线与互换分析。

skills.name: statistical-inference
skills.description: 统计检验与探索性分析。当用户要求做描述统计与分布诊断、选假设检验（t/ANOVA/卡方/非参）、判断两组或城市间差异是否显著、做相关性与配对分析、诊断时序平稳性与单位根、做多重比较校正，或对已有的本地 CSV/表格做探索性分析时使用。走柏讯服务端序列取数，价格类序列走本地 DAAS。

skills.name: equity-valuation
skills.description: 股票估值（DCF + 可比公司 + 三表联动）。当用户要求给某家 A 股/港股公司做内在价值或相对估值、算 WACC 与终值、跑敏感性与情景表、给目标价区间、做同业倍数对照与反推市场隐含预期时使用。财务数据走柏讯服务端通道 A，价格与市值走本地 DAAS 通道 B；通道 B 未连接时中止估值，不给目标价。

skills.name: earnings-cycle-analysis
skills.description: 财报周期分析（前瞻 + 复盘）。当用户要求对一家公司做财报前瞻（本次披露类型与时间、该盯哪些科目、超预期/低于预期可能从哪来）、做财报复盘（实际 vs 上年同期、差异由哪个科目驱动、盈利质量如何、对后续季度意味着什么），或梳理连续数期经营动能变化时使用。基于柏讯财报与公告数据，不做技术分析。触发词：财报前瞻、业绩预告、财报复盘、业绩点评、超预期、低于预期、盈利质量、某某公司季报/半年报/年报分析。

skills.name: ic-adjudication
skills.description: 柏讯投委会 · 裁决（入口技能）。当用户要求"开投委会""对某只股票做一次多空辩论并给结论""裁决多头空头的分歧""把辩论结论落账"时使用。本技能是套件入口：调度 ic-bull-case 与 ic-bear-case 双方立论，然后按四条裁决纪律给出 Rating 契约实例（冲突不给 hold 须指强弱、证据不足给 review 不降级、裁决不引用任何数字、change_my_mind 必填），并完成落账（账本不可用时明示"未落账"）。单 agent 分角色形态，不构成独立视角。

skills.name: ic-bull-case
skills.description: 柏讯投委会 · 多头立论。当用户要求对某只股票构建看多论证、写多头观点、准备投委会辩论的多方意见、把证据集收敛成"为什么该买"的最强论证，或作为 ic-adjudication 的立论阶段被调度时使用。本技能不取数、不计算、不裁决——数字只能引用证据集的 evidence_id，论证组织是唯一职责。与 ic-bear-case 对称，空头未发言时不得替对手立论。

skills.name: ic-bear-case
skills.description: 柏讯投委会 · 空头立论（辩论三角色之一，与 ic-bull-case 完全对称）。当用户在投委会辩论流程中需要空头方论证、问「有什么理由不买」「多头论证哪里站不住」「估值凭什么下修」，或作为 ic-adjudication 的立论阶段被调度时使用。本技能不取数、不计算、不裁决——数字只能引用证据集的 evidence_id；不同意多头时只能提出新证据或指出其适用边界，不得改写数字。空头论证为空是合法产出，不得为对称而编造。

canonical.brief: 基于张海燕四步审查法+何力/常金光三观分析法，对合同进行深度审查。支持企业核验、多语言自动检测、Mermaid业务流程图、二段式审核意见、合同概览、客户可读合同编号、业务摘要、22类合同专项审查、续约提醒和 Word 修订模式审核红线稿。飞书正式交付物必须包含问题卡片列表和业务流程图；用户选择修订模式时，以原合同为只读来源，先生成 redline-plan.json，再运行 scripts/redline/apply_redline_plan.py 生成带真实修订痕迹和批注的 Word 审核修订稿，并完成红线 QA。其他记录保存为本地 Markdown。

canonical.brief: 从已开发代码项目中提取技术实现证据，围绕候选专利方案生成算法/软件类说明书式技术交底书，并以“权利要求布局卡 → 发明专利初稿”两步法继续生成接近可申报版的中国发明专利起草材料。触发场景包括：读取代码仓库后撰写技术交底书、将人工总结的专利方案映射到具体实现、从代码中挖掘可专利技术方案、为专利代理师准备权利要求布局和发明专利初稿。

canonical.brief: Legal Visualization。面向法律业务场景的法律图解与图表生成技能；当用户要求把案件材料、合同材料、合规事项、交易安排、证据链、诉讼流程、时间轴、法律关系、客户汇报、法律服务方案或律师团队工作整理成关系图、流程图、时间轴、证据链、风险图、路线图、PNG/SVG/PDF/.drawio 时使用；也兼容“法律可视化”“案件事实图”“法律关系图”等说法。先按受众、任务动词和路由规则筛选场景，再生成可交付图片，并保留 draw.io 源文件作为可编辑底稿。本技能不用于事实核验，也不替代法律结论判断。

canonical.brief: 将案件/咨询/商标/专利材料整理成标准化目录结构。支持诉讼案件（12目录）、潜在项目/咨询（2目录）、商标案件（按业务子类型选 2 个模板：注册 7 目录含独立商标注册证/异议复审无效 8 目录含独立商标注册证）、专利案件（按业务子类型选 3 个模板：申请 7 目录/复审无效 8 目录/检索其他 4 目录，目录顺序按项目进展）四种预设。本技能应在用户需要创建新案件、初始化案件目录结构、整理咨询材料、接收商标/专利新业务、或通过参数和自然语言指定案件编号、委托人、案件类型等信息快速创建案件时使用。不要用于：单独生成法律文书、进行法律研究、证据分析等非案件初始化任务。

canonical.brief: 面向 OPC（One Person Company，一人公司 / 单人创业者 + AI 协同）和小微企业经营场景的法律业务分诊与判断技能。用户咨询主体选择、公私分离、联合创始人、融资与激励、合同履约、财税风险、AI 产品、数据与知识产权、用工、监管或争议时使用。负责识别主矛盾、联动风险、行动优先级和升级边界；凡涉及现行法条、效力状态、期限、税率、备案名录、地方政策、办理口径或平台规则，生成结构化检索任务并交由可用法律数据库、MCP 或官方来源核验，不以内置知识冒充最新规则。不要用于替代正式法律意见、深度合同批注、诉讼文书、商标申请、专利分析或纯法规检索。

canonical.brief: 面向中国发明和实用新型专利的结构化初步分析工具。本技能应在用户需要拆解或解释权利要求、比较专利保护范围、进行产品侵权比对、等同分析、稳定性与无效风险分析、FTO、规避设计、专利价值评估或制作专利分析图表时使用。不要用于：代替专利律师或专利代理师出具正式意见、仅下载/OCR专利、撰写专利申请文件，或在未确认法域与有效权利要求时给出确定性结论；外观设计近似判断需另行采用专门方法并人工复核。

canonical.brief: 将法律文本（法律条文或法律案例）转换为规范的 Markdown 格式，删除推广冗余信息。本技能应在用户需要处理法律条文（如民法典、刑法等）、整理法律案例（如最高法典型案例、裁判文书等）、或从粘贴文本中格式化法律文档时使用。注意：本技能只负责格式化和内容清理，不包含内容抓取能力。内容获取应由其他 skill（如 wechat-article-fetch）完成，AI 会自动判断技能协作顺序。

canonical.brief: 法律溯因推理（Abductive Reasoning）技能，用于在证据不完整、事实模糊时生成并评估最合理的解释性假设。结合米尔五法（求同、求异、求同求异、剩余、共变）进行结构化因果推断。当用户需要"提出可能的法律解释"、"生成辩护/起诉假设"、"评估证据的多种解读"或"基于不完整事实推断最佳解释"时触发。适用于案例分析、证据评估、规则适用争议、因果关系推断等场景。

canonical.brief: 当AI智能体需要将法律推理结果组织为完整、自洽、有说服力的论证结构时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 撰写法律意见书、代理词、辩护词、答辩状等法律文书中的论证部分 - 回答用户提出的复杂法律问题，需要多步骤推理并呈现结论 - 对争议焦点进行系统性分析，需要构建从事实到法律到结论的完整推理路径 - 反驳对方观点时，需要构建替代性论证链条 - 对多个法律问题进行综合分析，需要确保各论证之间逻辑一致、互不矛盾 - 在法律研究备忘录中呈现分析结论 触发信号关键词：论证、分析、推理、为什么、证明、理由、论述、阐述观点、法律分析

canonical.brief: 当AI智能体完成一段法律推理或论证后，需要对该推理结论进行自我评估，判断论证的整体强度与置信度，识别并标注推理链条中的薄弱环节。 触发条件包括但不限于： - 完成法律分析后需要给出结论可靠性评级 - 用户明确要求评估某一论证的说服力或可靠性 - 存在多个竞争性法律解释需要比较论证强度 - 推理过程中涉及不确定因素（事实不明、法律空白、争议观点）需要标注 - 为决策者提供风险提示，说明结论的局限性 - 对己方或对方的法律论证进行攻防强度评估 - 在法律意见书、备忘录等文书中需要附加置信度说明

canonical.brief: 当AI智能体在法律推理过程中遇到以下情形时触发本技能：(1)多个法律条文均可适用于同一事实（法条竞合）；(2)不同证据之间存在矛盾或不一致（证据矛盾）；(3)案件存在多个争议焦点需要确定审理或分析顺序（争点优先级排序）；(4)不同法律渊源（法律、法规、司法解释、地方性法规等）对同一问题作出不同规定（法源冲突）；(5)当事人主张与法律适用之间存在张力需要协调。本技能是法律推理的核心枢纽能力，几乎所有复杂法律分析都会涉及某种形式的冲突解决。

canonical.brief: 当需要评估'如果某一事实/行为/条件不存在或发生改变，法律结果将如何不同'时触发此技能。典型触发场景包括：因果关系认定（若无该行为，损害是否仍会发生）、过错与责任比例划分、损害赔偿范围确定、合同违约损失计算、行政行为合法性假设检验、刑事因果关系中断判断、立法影响评估等。核心方法是构建一个与现实世界仅在目标变量上不同的'反事实世界'，比较两个世界的结果差异，从而得出目标变量对结果的贡献程度。

canonical.brief: 当用户提交合同文本、交易安排、商业协议或法律关系描述，需要评估其中可能产生法律纠纷或违约风险时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户要求审查合同并指出潜在风险 - 用户询问某项交易安排是否存在履约障碍 - 用户描述合同执行中的困难，需要判断是否构成违约 - 用户要求对合同条款进行风险评级 - 用户提供两方或多方之间的协议，要求识别可能的争议焦点 - 用户描述已发生的履约偏差，需要评估法律后果 - 合同审查、尽职调查、交易谈判等场景中需要前瞻性风险识别 此技能聚焦于"是否会产生法律纠纷"和"是否存在违约风险"两大核心问题， 输出结构化的风险清单与应对建议。

canonical.brief: 争议焦点识别是指在法律要素提取之后，从法律事实中提取争议焦点，进一步将案件关系转化为法律关系问题。 能够排除无争议事项，能够有效围绕当事人争议的事实、证据和法律适用等焦点问题进行后续分析。 通过事实调查、证据审查等梳理再次确定争议焦点，可更加深入和靠近争议焦点的本质，将案件剖析的更加充分和透彻。

canonical.brief: 当需要将案件中的多项证据与法律论证主张进行系统性对应挂钩时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括：准备诉讼文书（起诉状、答辩状、代理词）时需要构建完整的证据-主张对应关系； 庭审前整理证据目录并明确每项证据的证明目的；对方提出反驳后需要重新组织证据链以回应； 案件涉及多个争议焦点，需要将证据分组归类到不同论证主张下； 需要评估现有证据是否足以支撑全部主张，识别证据链中的薄弱环节和缺口。 本技能的核心是建立"主张→要件→证据→证明力评估"的完整映射关系，确保每个法律主张都有充分的证据支撑， 每项证据都有明确的证明目的，整体论证链条逻辑严密、层次清晰。

canonical.brief: 当需要对案件中的证据材料进行真实性、合法性、关联性（证据"三性"）及证明力评估时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 当事人或代理人提交证据后，需要判断该证据能否被法庭采纳 - 对方当事人对己方证据提出质证意见，需要进行回应和分析 - 需要对全案证据进行综合评判，确定待证事实是否成立 - 需要判断证据是否达到相应的证明标准（如高度盖然性、排除合理怀疑等） - 需要识别证据链中的薄弱环节并提出补强建议 - 电子数据、鉴定意见、证人证言等特殊证据形式的效力判断 - 非法证据排除的识别与论证

canonical.brief: 当需要根据已确认的法律事实、已识别的法律关系和已匹配的法律规范，推导出具体的法律后果（包括但不限于民事责任类型与范围、损害赔偿金额计算、刑事刑期确定、行政处罚种类与幅度、合同效力状态等）时，触发本技能。 典型触发场景包括： - 用户询问"我能获得多少赔偿""对方要承担什么责任" - 用户询问"这个行为会判几年""罚款多少" - 需要从法律构成要件满足情况推导出具体法律效果 - 需要计算具体赔偿数额、刑期范围、违约金数额等量化结果 - 需要综合考虑加重、减轻、免除等调整因素后得出最终法律后果 本技能是法律推理链条的终端环节，将抽象的法律规范转化为具体的、可操作的法律结论。

canonical.brief: 当需要从一个或多个具体案例、判决、事实模式中提炼、总结出一般性法律规则、裁判规则或法律原则时，触发此技能。典型触发场景包括：用户要求从系列案例中归纳裁判要旨、从个案中提炼可推广的法律命题、从多个事实模式中识别共同法律规则、构建类案检索的裁判规则摘要、以及从实务判例中总结司法适用标准。

canonical.brief: 当需要对企业内部的合规管理体系进行系统性审查，识别制度缺漏、流程缺陷和数据隐私合规风险时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 企业委托律师或合规顾问进行内部合规风险评估 - 企业拟上市、并购或接受监管检查前进行合规自查 - 发生合规事件后，需要排查管理体系中的系统性缺陷 - 企业建立或更新合规管理体系时，需要评估现有制度与法律法规的匹配度 - 用户要求审查企业内部规章制度、核心业务流程或隐私政策协议的合规性 本技能覆盖三大审查维度：制度体系完整性审查、业务流程控制有效性审查、个人信息保护合规性审查。

canonical.brief: 辅助法官在权利冲突、法律不确定、比例原则审查和裁量说理场景中，进行结构化、可审查、可论证的司法价值判断。 本 Skill 用于辅助法官在疑难案件中识别法律价值冲突、确定裁量边界、展开价值衡量，并形成可用于裁判说理的分析框架，不替代法官作出最终裁判，而是帮助法官将价值判断转化为有事实基础、规范基础和论证结构的司法推理过程。

canonical.brief: 当需要对判决书、裁定书、调解书、仲裁裁决书、行政处罚决定书等法律文书进行结构化摘要时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户要求对一份法律文书做摘要、提炼要点或生成裁判要旨 - 用户需要将多份法律文书转化为可对比、可检索的标准化摘要 - 用户要求提取案件信息、争议焦点、法律依据或说理过程 - 用户需要为案例研究、诉讼分析、教学备课准备摘要材料 - 用户要求区分不同文书类型（判决/裁定/调解/仲裁/行政处罚）的摘要重点 本技能的核心价值：在忠实于原文的基础上，将冗长法律文书转化为简明、客观、结构化的摘要，突出核心内容，避免复述全文和主观评价。

canonical.brief: 当需要从案件描述、当事人陈述、聊天记录、媒体报道等非结构化文本中提取具有法律意义的事实时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户提供一段日常语言的案件描述，要求提取法律事实 - 用户要求将口语化、情绪化的叙事转化为法律分析可用的事实结构 - 用户要求区分案件叙述中的"客观事实""主观判断"和"法律评价" - 用户要求将提取的事实对应到特定法律关系的构成要件 - 用户要求整理案件时间轴或制作事实梳理表 - 用户要求将生活语言转化为法律语言（如"他一直拖着不还"→"履行期限届满后未履行"） 本技能的核心价值：将混杂的生活叙事整理为可进入法律推理的事实结构，是法律分析的前置步骤。

canonical.brief: 当法律推理过程中遇到以下情形时触发本技能： （1）法条文本含义模糊、存在多种理解可能； （2）法条适用于具体案件事实时产生争议； （3）需要论证某一法条应当/不应当适用于特定情形； （4）当事人双方对同一法条的理解存在分歧； （5）法条之间存在表面冲突，需要通过解释协调； （6）新型案件事实无法直接对应既有法条文本； （7）需要对裁判文书中的法律适用进行分析或质疑。 本技能的核心是运用文义解释、体系解释、目的解释等法律解释方法，对关键法条进行严谨的解释论证，得出合理、可辩护的法律含义，并以规范化的方式呈现解释过程与结论。

canonical.brief: 当AI智能体在法律推理过程中检索到具体法律条文后，需要对该法条进行效力验证时触发此技能。 触发条件包括但不限于： 1. 智能体引用任何法律条文作为推理依据前； 2. 用户提供法条要求分析其适用性时； 3. 多个法律规范可能存在冲突需要判断优先适用时； 4. 法律文件的时间效力存疑（可能已被修订、废止）时； 5. 需要确认某规范性文件是否具有法律约束力时； 6. 跨层级、跨区域法律规范适用产生疑问时。 本技能确保智能体引用的每一条法律规范均为现行有效、层级正确、与上位法及同位法无冲突， 从而保障法律推理结论的可靠性和权威性。

canonical.brief: 当AI智能体在生成、审查或修改任何法律文本（包括但不限于合同、诉状、法律意见书、裁判文书、法规释义、法律备忘录等）时，需要确保其中使用的法律术语措辞准确、无歧义、符合法律文体要求。该技能在以下场景触发： 1. 起草或修改法律文书时，需要选择正确的法律术语； 2. 审查法律文本时，发现术语使用不规范、混淆或存在歧义； 3. 将日常用语转化为法律规范表达时； 4. 翻译或对照中外法律术语时； 5. 用户明确要求对法律文本进行术语规范化处理时； 6. 对法律概念进行精确定义或解释时。 本技能是法律写作的基础原子能力，贯穿所有法律文本生产环节。

canonical.brief: 当需要对多份相关文档进行综合分析、提取共同观点、识别冲突并生成统一概览时触发此技能。 典型触发场景包括但不限于： - 用户上传多份判决书、裁定书，要求总结类案裁判要旨 - 用户提供多个合同文本，要求归纳条款异同和关键差异 - 用户提供多份法律法规、司法解释，要求梳理规范演变和适用要点 - 用户提供多个证据材料、调查笔录，要求整合事实脉络 - 用户提供多篇学术论文、研究报告，要求提炼研究共识和分歧 - 用户要求对比多份法律意见书的观点差异 本技能的核心价值：不是简单压缩单篇文档，而是构建跨文档的关联分析，识别共性与差异，生成新的综合性洞见。

canonical.brief: 当智能体需要检索法律条文、司法解释、典型案例之外的辅助性法律信息时触发此技能。具体包括但不限于：立法背景资料（草案说明、审议报告、立法机关答记者问）、监管案例与行政处罚决定、地方指导意见与会议纪要、部门规章的起草说明与政策解读、行业标准与技术规范、法律实施情况报告、人大常委会执法检查报告、白皮书与政策文件、学术通说与权威教材观点、域外法律比较资料等。当用户问题涉及'为什么这样规定''立法目的是什么''实践中监管部门怎么处理''地方上有什么特殊规定''行业惯例是什么'等语境时，应当触发本技能。

canonical.brief: 当法律分析中存在多个可能的结论、风险点或争议焦点时，需要对这些风险按照发生概率和影响程度进行系统化排序，以帮助决策者聚焦最关键的风险并合理分配资源。该技能在以下场景触发：(1)法律尽职调查中发现多项合规风险需要排序；(2)诉讼策略制定中需要评估多个不利结论的可能性与后果；(3)交易结构设计中需要识别并排列关键法律障碍；(4)合同审查中发现多个风险条款需要确定修改优先级；(5)监管合规评估中需要对多项违规风险进行分级管理；(6)任何需要在有限资源下对法律风险进行战略性取舍的场景。

canonical.brief: 当AI智能体需要对一个法律问题、案件事实、法律条文或法律关系进行系统性分析时，首先必须将其分解为结构化的要素清单。该技能在以下场景触发： - 接收到一段案件事实描述，需要提取全部法律要素后再进行分析 - 需要判断某一法律关系是否成立（如合同成立、侵权构成、犯罪构成） - 需要对比两个或多个法律事实/条文的异同 - 在进入法律推理、法律适用、法律建议等下游任务之前，作为前置质量关卡 - 用户明确要求"列出要素""逐项分析""检查是否遗漏" 本技能的核心目标是：确保要素提取完整、无遗漏，形成可追溯、可验证的结构化清单，然后才允许进入下一阶段推理。它是法律分析链条中的"质量闸门"。

canonical.brief: 目的解释技能。当法律条文经过文义解释后仍无法得出确定结论时，通过系统性地发现并论证该条文的目的，在文本可承受范围内选择最正当的含义，形成可裁判的解释结论。触发条件（满足任一即可）：文义解释存在两种以上可能无法择一；文义解释结论明显不合理；条文含开放性评价概念（如"合理""正当""必要""重大"）；条文较旧、面对新型事实时文义覆盖不足。

canonical.brief: 劳动补偿金与经济补偿金计算器（识律劳动法套件原子技能，双计算器之一）。当用户要求计算解除劳动合同经济补偿 N、违法解除赔偿金 2N、代通知金 N+1、未签书面劳动合同二倍工资差额、加班费、未休年休假工资报酬，或需要判断三倍封顶（社平工资三倍 × 12 年上限）时使用。法律依据走识律条级解析，数值基数走柏讯统计源，每个结果强制附公式与基数来源。

canonical.brief: 面板数据计量分析。当用户要在"个体 × 时间"二维结构上做推断时使用——固定效应/随机效应与 Hausman 检验、聚类稳健标准误、动态面板（滞后因变量）、双重差分 DID 与平行趋势/事件研究检验、断点回归概念。面板取自柏讯服务端三类源：GTA 上市公司（firm-year）、中国城市（city-year）、世界银行 WDI（country-year），宏观控制变量取柏讯宏观序列。不涉及股价与市值建模。

canonical.brief: 财报周期分析（前瞻 + 复盘）。当用户要求对一家公司做财报前瞻（本次披露类型与时间、该盯哪些科目、超预期/低于预期可能从哪来）、做财报复盘（实际 vs 上年同期、差异由哪个科目驱动、盈利质量如何、对后续季度意味着什么），或梳理连续数期经营动能变化时使用。基于柏讯财报与公告数据，不做技术分析。触发词：财报前瞻、业绩预告、财报复盘、业绩点评、超预期、低于预期、盈利质量、某某公司季报/半年报/年报分析。

tools.name: list_services
tools.description:
List all MCP servers registered in the registry. Use search_registry
instead if you know what capability you need (faster, ranked results).

Each server entry includes its endpoint URL, tools, and connection details.
Use this for browsing the full catalog or when you need an unfiltered list.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description:
List all agents registered in the registry. Use search_registry
instead if you know what task you need an agent for (faster, ranked).

Agents are autonomous services you can delegate tasks to. Each entry
includes the agent's URL, capabilities, and skills.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description:
List all skills registered in the registry. Use search_registry
instead if you know what workflow you need (faster, ranked results).

Skills are reusable workflow instructions (like slash commands) that
you can load and execute. Use get_skill_content to retrieve the full
markdown instructions for a discovered skill.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing skills, total_count, and status

tools.name: get_skill_content
tools.description:
Retrieve the full instructions for a skill. Call this after finding a
skill via search_registry to get its complete workflow markdown.

The returned content is a SKILL.md file containing step-by-step
instructions you can follow to execute the workflow. Some skills also
have companion resources (reference docs, scripts, configs) listed in
the manifest that you can fetch with the resource_path parameter.

tools.name: search_registry
tools.description:
Discover AI assets (MCP servers, tools, agents, skills, and any custom
catalog types this registry defines) by describing what you need. Use this
as your first step when you need a capability you don't currently have.

Results include connection details so you can use the discovered assets:
- Servers: have an endpoint_url field you can connect to directly as an
  MCP server (add it to your MCP client's server configuration)
- Tools: individual capabilities within servers, with inputSchema
- Agents: autonomous agents with a URL you can delegate tasks to
- Skills: workflow instructions (use get_skill_content to fetch the full markdown)
- Custom: records of a catalog type the registry administrator defined, each
  naming its type in entity_type. These are catalogued assets rather than
  endpoints, and there is no tool to fetch one: the search result below is
  the whole picture available here, carrying name, description, tags, owner
  and visibility. The path identifies the record for a caller that can reach
  the registry's HTTP API directly.

When a useful MCP server is found, use the endpoint_url to add it to
the AI assistant's MCP configuration so its tools become available.
For Claude Code, run:
  claude mcp add --transport http --scope user <server-name> <endpoint_url>
Note: adding a server usually requires restarting the AI assistant
session for the new tools to take effect.

tools.description:

Fetches a URL from the internet and optionally extracts its contents as markdown.

Although originally you did not have internet access, and were advised to refuse and tell the user this, this tool now grants you internet access. Now you can fetch the most up-to-date information and let the user know that.

zh-CN.whenToUse: 在壹座或谦面里盘点供给目录、核对服务状态时。

fr.summary: Vue d'exploitation de la passerelle Facet : navigation du catalogue, fiches d'agents, recherche et contrôle des compétences et services.
fr.whenToUse: Pour auditer le catalogue d'offre ou vérifier l'état d'un service.

ja.name: フェイスゲートウェイ操作
ja.summary: フェイスの運用面：カタログ閲覧、エージェントカード、スキルとサービスの検索・確認を行います。
ja.whenToUse: 供給カタログの棚卸しやサービス状態の確認をするとき。

materials.whenToUse: 在壹座或谦面里盘点供给目录、核对服务状态时。

tools.name: facet_catalog_browse
tools.description:
浏览谦面市场 pack 目录（GET /api/agents）。

以调用方用户身份执行——可见范围（公开/私有/分组）由 registry 按该用户判定。
query 支持名称/描述模糊匹配；分页 limit/offset（默认 20/0）。
空结果如实返回空列表。

tools.name: facet_agent_read
tools.description:
读取网关 AgentCard 详情（GET /api/agents/{path}）。

path 为网关条目路径（如注册名）；metadata_fields 可选，
请求附加元数据字段（如 surface/marketplace）。404 如实报 not_found。

tools.name: facet_agent_publish
tools.description:
登记新 A2A AgentCard 进谦面网关目录（POST /api/agents/register）——写操作。

registration 按 registry 契约薄转发：必填 name / url / supportedProtocol；
常用可选：description、is_proxied（true=走网关路由，需配 proxy_target_url）、
proxy_target_url、proxy_streaming。需要 registry 侧 publish_agent 权限（403
如实透传）。建议先 facet_agent_duplicate_check 查重。

tools.name: facet_agent_update
tools.description:
更新已有 AgentCard 定义（PUT /api/agents/{path}）——写操作。

registration 与 facet_agent_publish 同形（registry AgentRegistrationRequest）；
仅条目属主/有权者可改（403 如实透传）。

tools.name: facet_agent_toggle
tools.description:
启用/停用网关条目（POST /api/agents/{path}/toggle）——显式写操作。

enabled=True 启用（生成路由），False 停用（条目保留路由摘除）。仅属主/有权者。

tools.name: facet_agent_duplicate_check
tools.description:
登记前咨询式查重（POST /api/agents/check-duplicates）——恒 200，不阻塞。

返回 collision_with（同 URL 精确命中）与 advisory_matches（相似命中）；
有匹配也可继续登记（advisory 语义）。self_path 用于排除自身。

tools.name: alerts_list_series
tools.description:
Distinct (source, function_name, indicator) from observations + scraw_* tables,
each with a row count + latest date. Alert-scoped discovery (not a SQL browser).

tools.name: alerts_get_series_latest
tools.description: Return the latest `limit` rows of a series ordered by date_column desc.

tools.name: alerts_create_alert_rule
tools.description:
Create a trigger rule over a DB series.

`condition` is a safe DSL (no eval): `latest > 70`, `crosses_above(70)`,
`pct_change(5) > 0.05`, `latest > 70 and prev <= 70`, etc. `channels` is a
list of names (["telegram","slack"]) or a {name: override} object. All
channel credentials live in root .env under ALERTS_*.

tools.name: alerts_list_alert_rules
tools.description: Return all alert rules.

tools.name: alerts_get_alert_rule
tools.description: Return one rule by name.

tools.name: alerts_update_alert_rule
tools.description: Update a rule's fields. Only provided fields change. The name cannot be renamed.

tools.name: alerts_delete_alert_rule
tools.description: Delete a rule. Its alert_events rows are removed via FK CASCADE.

tools.name: alerts_list_channels
tools.description:
Return {name, configured, missing_keys} for each of the 7 channels
(telegram, discord, slack, twitter, dingtalk, feishu, wecowork).

Never returns credential values — only the names of missing keys.

tools.name: alerts_run_alert_rule
tools.description:
Ad-hoc: evaluate one rule now and dispatch if it fires.

Respects fire_mode + cooldown like the cron path. Use to test a rule on demand.

tools.name: alerts_list_events
tools.description: Recent alert_events (optionally for one rule), newest first.

tools.name: cron_create_schedule
tools.description: Create a new schedule with a cron expression and task.

tools.name: cron_list_schedules
tools.description: List all schedules.

tools.name: cron_get_schedule
tools.description: Get details for a single schedule.

tools.name: cron_delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a schedule permanently.

tools.name: cron_pause_schedule
tools.description: Pause a schedule (disable without deleting).

tools.name: cron_resume_schedule
tools.description: Resume a paused schedule.

tools.name: cron_run_now
tools.description: Execute a scheduled task immediately (one-shot).

tools.name: cron_list_executions
tools.description: List execution history, optionally filtered by schedule_id.

tools.name: cron_list_tasks
tools.description: List available task types in the registry.

tools.name: cron_create_task
tools.description:
Register a new task in the database. The command is a shell command or script path.

Example: create_task(name="fetch_mofcom", command="python3 scripts/fetch_mofcom_news.py --json")

tools.name: cron_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task from the database by name.

tools.name: cron_list_db_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks stored in the database (user-defined, no code changes needed).

tools.name: cron_update_task
tools.description: Update an existing DB task's command, description, or timeout. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: composite_list
tools.description: List all defined composites (name + description).

tools.name: composite_create
tools.description: Create a new composite. Raises if the name already exists.

tools.name: composite_list_upstreams
tools.description: List the upstreams defined for a composite.

tools.name: composite_add_upstream
tools.description:
Add an upstream MCP server to a composite.

For stdio: provide command, args, cwd (env optional).
For http: provide url.

tools.name: composite_remove_upstream
tools.description: Remove an upstream (and its selected tools) from a composite.

tools.name: composite_list_available_tools
tools.description: List the tools an upstream currently exposes (live), optionally filtered.

tools.name: composite_add_tool
tools.description:
Select an upstream tool to be exposed (proxied) by the composite.

The tool is served as <upstream_key>_<tool_name> on next start.
(alias is accepted but unused in v1.)

tools.name: composite_remove_tool
tools.description: Remove a selected tool from a composite.

tools.name: composite_list_tools
tools.description: List the tools currently selected for a composite.

tools.name: composite_add_chained_tool
tools.description:
Define a chained tool: a linear pipeline of upstream tool calls.

Each step is {"upstream": <key>, "tool": <name>, "input": {param: value}}.
Input values may be literals or references: "$prev.<path>" (prior step's
result) or "$step[N].<path>" (any prior step's result). Linear only — no
branching/conditionals.

tools.name: composite_remove_chained_tool
tools.description: Remove a chained tool from a composite.

tools.name: composite_list_chained_tools
tools.description: List the chained tools defined for a composite.

tools.name: composite_create_manifest
tools.description: Create a composite manifest: composite + upstreams + tools + workflows + prompt in one call.

tools.name: composite_update_manifest
tools.description:
Partially update a composite manifest. Only provided fields change.

upstreams/tools (when given) REPLACE the existing sets wholesale.

tools.name: composite_delete_manifest
tools.description: Delete a composite manifest (cascades upstreams/tools/chains).

tools.name: composite_list_manifests
tools.description: List all composites as manifests (name, upstreams, tools, workflows, prompt).

tools.name: daas_list_sources
tools.description:
List all configured DAAS data sources with function counts.

Returns sources like akshare, worldbank, ckan, cnstats
with install status and available function counts.

tools.name: daas_search_functions
tools.description: Search DAAS functions by name, category, or description across all sources.

tools.name: daas_get_function_detail
tools.description: Get full details for a DAAS function — parameters, output columns, description.

tools.name: daas_list_categories
tools.description: List all DAAS function categories with counts, optionally filtered by source.

tools.name: daas_fetch_data
tools.description:
Execute a DAAS data function and return results as JSON.

Routes to the correct source adapter based on function name prefix.

tools.name: daas_create_datasource
tools.description: Create a new managed datasource.

tools.name: daas_update_datasource
tools.description:
Update mutable fields of a datasource, identified by name or id.

Pass clear_category=true to unset the category (move to root level).
Pass score=<float> to set the default score; pass clear_score=true to reset
the score back to NULL (unset). Only supplied fields are changed.

tools.name: daas_delete_datasource
tools.description:
Delete a datasource and cascade-delete its forms, sections, and
collection-item references. Identify by name or id.

tools.name: daas_create_category
tools.description: Create a category, optionally under a parent (building the tree).

tools.name: daas_move_category
tools.description:
Re-parent a category. Rejects moves that would create a cycle
(into own descendant) or self-parenting. Pass parent_id=null to make
it a root.

tools.name: daas_delete_category
tools.description:
Delete a category. Rejected if it has child categories. Datasources
assigned to it are orphaned to root level (category_id set to null).

tools.name: daas_get_category_tree
tools.description:
Return the category tree (or a subtree from root_id) as a nested
structure, each node annotated with datasource_count.

tools.name: daas_add_form
tools.description: Add a form (e.g. '10-K', '8-K') to a datasource.

tools.name: daas_add_section
tools.description: Add a section to a form, carrying an extraction instruction.

tools.name: daas_list_forms
tools.description:
List all forms of a datasource, each with nested sections
(including instruction).

tools.name: daas_create_collection
tools.description: Create a named datasource collection.

tools.name: daas_add_to_collection
tools.description:
Add a datasource (or a specific datasource-section) to a collection.

Omit section_name to add the whole datasource; supply section_name to
add only that section. Optional score sets a per-collection score override
on the new item (NULL = inherit the datasource's default score).

tools.name: daas_list_collection_items
tools.description:
List a collection's items, each resolved to source name and (if set)
section name + instruction.

tools.name: daas_remove_from_collection
tools.description:
Remove an item from a collection by (collection, source, optional
section). Omit section_name to remove the whole-datasource item.

tools.name: daas_list_collections
tools.description: List every datasource collection with its item count.

tools.name: daas_rename_collection
tools.description:
Rename a collection. The new name must be unique. Items are preserved
(they reference by collection_id).

tools.name: daas_update_collection
tools.description:
Partially update a collection's name and/or description.

At least one of `new_name` / `description` must be provided; omitted
fields are left unchanged. When `new_name` differs from the current
name it must be unique. Raises if the collection is not found.

tools.name: daas_delete_collection
tools.description:
Delete a collection. Cascades to its `datasource_collection_items`
rows (datasources themselves are untouched).

tools.name: daas_reorder_collection_items
tools.description:
Rewrite the sort_order of items in `collection_name` to match the
given list. `ordered_item_ids` MUST include every existing item id in
the collection exactly once — partial reorders are rejected.

tools.name: daas_set_collection_item_score
tools.description:
Set or clear the per-collection score override on an existing collection
item, identified by (collection_name, source_name, optional section_name).

Pass score=<float> to set the override; pass score=null (omit) to clear it
so the item falls back to the datasource's default score. Returns the
updated item with its resolved effective score, the raw item_score override,
and the source_default_score.

tools.name: daas_search_datasources
tools.description:
Search/filter datasources across levels — category (with optional
subtree), source, form, and section — every filter optional, plus a
free-text query across source label/description, form label, and
section name/instruction.

tools.name: daas_search_entities
tools.description: Search entities (stocks + countries) by name, ticker, code, or alias.

tools.name: daas_get_entity
tools.description:
Get full detail for one entity, including aliases and metadata.

Per D5/3.5 the entity master is fd-open-data-mcp. Resolve by natural
key (entity_type, code) when given (gateway-first, local fallback);
otherwise fall back to entity_id (local).

tools.name: daas_list_entities
tools.description: List entities filtered by type / exchange / country, paginated.

tools.name: daas_get_entity_coverage
tools.description:
For each datasource linked to the entity, return the identifier to
use, the available sections (routing instructions = how to get the
data, with an identifier-prefilled variant), and the column count/list
aggregated from daas_function_columns. Sources without registered
functions get a column_hint naming the sibling MCP + tool.

Per D5/3.5 entity resolution proxies through fd-open-data-mcp. Accept
a natural key (entity_type, code) as an alternative to entity_id.

This answers: "I have company X — which datasources cover it, how many
columns can I get, and how do I fetch it?"

tools.name: daas_link_entity_datasource
tools.description:
Link an entity to a daas datasource, recording the identifier to use
inside that datasource (e.g. for AAPL → yfinance: 'AAPL'). Upserts on
(entity_id, source_name).

tools.name: daas_unlink_entity_datasource
tools.description: Delete the link between an entity and a datasource.

tools.name: daas_create_entity_collection
tools.description: Create a named entity collection (watchlist / portfolio).

tools.name: daas_list_entity_collections
tools.description: List every entity collection with its item count.

tools.name: daas_get_entity_collection
tools.description: Get one collection with its current member entities (ordered).

tools.name: daas_update_entity_collection
tools.description:
Partially update an entity collection's name and/or description and/or
rule. At least one field must be provided. `clear_rule=True` resets the
rule to NULL (manual collection).

tools.name: daas_delete_entity_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection and cascade to its items + changes.

tools.name: daas_add_entity_to_collection
tools.description:
Add an entity to a collection. Resolves the entity by `entity_id`, or
by `(entity_type, code)`. Records an `add_in` event in
`entity_collection_changes` (source='manual'). No-op (no event recorded)
if the entity is already a member.

tools.name: daas_remove_entity_from_collection
tools.description:
Remove an entity from a collection. Records a `remove_out` event in
`entity_collection_changes` (source='manual'). No-op (no event recorded)
if the entity is not a member.

tools.name: daas_list_entity_collection_items
tools.description:
List the current members of a collection, ordered by sort_order, each
enriched with full entity detail (code, name, ticker, exchange, ...).

tools.name: daas_reorder_entity_collection_items
tools.description:
Rewrite member sort_order to match the given ordered list of
`entity_collection_items.id`. Must contain exactly the current item ids.

tools.name: daas_list_entity_collection_changes
tools.description:
Query the add-in / remove-out audit log (`entity_collection_changes`),
newest first, each enriched with collection name + entity code/name.

tools.name: daas_sync_entity_collection
tools.description:
Re-derive the member set for a rule-based collection by applying its
`rule_json` to the `entities` table, diff vs current members, apply
add_in for new matches and remove_out for non-matches (source='cron'),
and record every transition. Returns `{added, removed, unchanged}`.
A manual collection (rule_json=NULL) is a no-op.

tools.name: daas_create_indicator_collection
tools.description: Create a named indicator collection (a reusable bundle of indicators).

tools.name: daas_list_indicator_collections
tools.description: List every indicator collection with its item count.

tools.name: daas_get_indicator_collection
tools.description:
Get one collection with its current items (ordered, each with the
resolved effective score + raw item/indicator/datasource scores).

tools.name: daas_update_indicator_collection
tools.description:
Partially update an indicator collection's name, description, and/or
rule. At least one field must be provided. `clear_rule=True` resets
`rule_id` to NULL (manual collection).

tools.name: daas_delete_indicator_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection and cascade to its items + changes.

tools.name: daas_add_indicator_to_collection
tools.description: Add an indicator to a collection. Resolves the indicator by `name`.

tools.name: daas_remove_indicator_from_collection
tools.description:
Remove an indicator from a collection. Records a `remove_out` event in
the audit log. No-op (`not_member`) if the indicator is not in the collection.

tools.name: daas_list_indicator_collection_items
tools.description:
List the items of a collection, ordered by sort_order, each with the
resolved effective score + raw item/indicator/datasource scores.

tools.name: daas_reorder_indicator_collection_items
tools.description:
Rewrite item sort_order to match the given ordered list of
`indicator_collection_items.id`. Must contain exactly the current item
ids of this collection — partial reorders are rejected.

tools.name: daas_set_indicator_collection_item_score
tools.description:
Set or clear the per-collection score override on an existing item,
identified by (collection_name, indicator_name).

`score` = a float sets the override; `score = null` clears it (the item
then inherits the indicator's default `indicator_rules.score`, which
itself inherits the datasource default when NULL). Returns the updated
item dict with the resolved effective score.

tools.name: daas_list_indicator_collection_changes
tools.description:
Query the add-in / remove-out audit log (`indicator_collection_changes`),
newest first. Each row is enriched with the collection name.

tools.name: daas_sync_indicator_collection
tools.description:
Re-derive the member set for a rule-based indicator collection by
evaluating its rule (target='indicator_names') via the RuleEngine, diff vs
current members, apply add_in/remove_out (source='cron'), and record every
transition. Returns `{added, removed, unchanged}`. A manual collection
(rule_id NULL) is a no-op.

tools.name: daas_create_pipeline_collection
tools.description: Create a named pipeline collection.

tools.name: daas_list_pipeline_collections
tools.description: Every pipeline collection with its item count.

tools.name: daas_get_pipeline_collection
tools.description: One pipeline collection with all its items.

tools.name: daas_delete_pipeline_collection
tools.description: Unwire cron for every item, then delete the collection (FK CASCADE removes items).

tools.name: daas_list_pipeline_items
tools.description: List items, optionally filtered to one collection.

tools.name: daas_add_pipeline_item
tools.description:
Validate + store an item. If enabled and backfill, run history backfill
then register the cron-mcp schedule. Returns {item, backfill, cron}.

tools.name: daas_remove_pipeline_item
tools.description: Unwire cron then delete the item row. scraw_<table> is left intact.

tools.name: daas_enable_pipeline_item
tools.description: Backfill + register cron for a disabled item; set enabled=1.

tools.name: daas_disable_pipeline_item
tools.description: Delete the cron schedule (keep the task row); set enabled=0.

tools.name: daas_update_pipeline_item
tools.description:
Update mutable fields. cron/timezone change re-syncs the schedule.
enabled toggle runs enable/disable. arguments_json change does NOT backfill.

tools.name: daas_sync_pipeline_cron
tools.description: Re-apply cron wiring for all enabled items; remove schedules for disabled ones.

tools.name: daas_list_models
tools.description: Return configured models with a `vision` flag each. API keys are never returned.

tools.name: daas_list_source_tables
tools.description: Return scraped source-data tables (name LIKE 'scraw_%') with row counts + columns.

tools.name: daas_create_rule
tools.description: Create a rule.

tools.name: daas_list_rules
tools.description: List all rules, optionally filtered by rule_type.

tools.name: daas_get_rule
tools.description: Return one rule by name.

tools.name: daas_update_rule
tools.description:
Partially update a rule. At least one field must be provided. The rule
name cannot be renamed.

tools.name: daas_delete_rule
tools.description:
Delete a rule. Referencing collections' rule_id is set to NULL; the
rule's process_results rows are removed.

tools.name: daas_run_rule
tools.description:
Evaluate + persist. For `target='rows'` (llm): incremental extraction
into process_results + advance last_rowid. For member targets: returns the
derived set (membership is applied by daas_sync_*_collection, not here).

tools.name: daas_test_rule
tools.description:
Dry-run: evaluate the rule WITHOUT persisting. For member targets
(entity_ids/indicator_names) returns the derived set. For `target='rows'`
(llm), extracts from a single source row (no process_results write) as a
sample.

tools.name: daas_extract_text
tools.description:
Extract structured records from (possibly long) text.

Long text is chunked (no truncation): per-chunk extraction then a merge pass.

tools.name: daas_extract_image
tools.description:
Extract structured records from an image via a vision-capable model.

`image` accepts a local file path, an http(s):// URL, or raw base64.

tools.name: daas_extract_file
tools.description: Read a local .txt/.md/.pdf and extract structured records.

tools.name: daas_list_indicator_ops
tools.description: Return the fixed math-op catalog with each op's required params.

tools.name: daas_create_indicator
tools.description: Create an indicator rule bound to a datasource + source table.

tools.name: daas_list_indicators
tools.description: Return all indicator rules (each with `score` + `effective_default_score`).

tools.name: daas_get_indicator
tools.description: Return one indicator rule by name (with `score` + `effective_default_score`).

tools.name: daas_update_indicator
tools.description:
Update an indicator rule's fields. Only provided fields change. The
rule name cannot be renamed. Pass `params` to replace the op params.

`score`: a float sets the indicator's default score. `clear_score=True`
clears it back to NULL (inherit the datasource's `sources.score`).
Mirrors `update_datasource(score=…, clear_score=True)`.

tools.name: daas_set_indicator_score
tools.description:
Set the indicator's default `score` (float), or clear it (None → inherit
the datasource's `sources.score`). Returns the updated indicator dict with
`effective_default_score`.

tools.name: daas_delete_indicator
tools.description:
Delete an indicator rule. observations rows it produced are NOT removed
(soft reference) — they remain identifiable via their `metadata.rule_name`.

tools.name: daas_run_indicator
tools.description:
Full-recompute the indicator over its source table → observations.

Reads the whole source table, computes the op, and upserts every
(date, value) into the daas `observations` table keyed on
(source=datasource, function_name, indicator=indicator_name, date).
Idempotent on re-run via the observations unique constraint.

tools.name: daas_calculate_indicator
tools.description:
Ad-hoc: compute an indicator over a source table without persisting.

Validates table/columns/op/params, reads the series, computes, and returns
{indicator, dates, values, count}. Writes nothing (no rule, no observations).

tools.name: dashboard_list_databases
tools.description: List all known SQLite databases in the MCP directory with table counts.

tools.name: dashboard_query_table
tools.description: Run a read-only query against a database table. Returns rows as JSON.

tools.name: dashboard_list_datasources
tools.description: List managed datasources from daas.db (schema managed by mcp/models/models.py).

tools.name: dashboard_get_executions
tools.description: Get cron execution history from a database.

tools.name: dashboard_get_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated statistics across all MCP databases.

tools.name: dashboard_register
tools.description:
Register or update (upsert by slug) a standalone HTML dashboard in the
`dashboards` table. After writing the row, regenerates index.html + daas.md
from the DB. `source_tables`/`entity_coverage`/`time_range`/`chart_config`
accept a JSON string or a list/dict. Returns the stored row (with `action`
= inserted|updated) or `{"error": ...}`.

tools.name: dashboard_list
tools.description:
List every registered dashboard (name + slug + intro + file_url), oldest
first. Returns a JSON array.

tools.name: dashboard_get
tools.description:
Get one dashboard's full metadata by slug: name, intro, source_tables,
entity_coverage, time_range, refresh_cadence, chart_config, file_path,
file_url. Returns `{"error": "dashboard '<slug>' not found"}` if absent.

tools.name: dashboard_search
tools.description:
Case-insensitive keyword search over each dashboard's name + intro +
refresh_cadence + source_tables. Returns matching `{slug, name, intro}`
entries, or an empty array if none match.

tools.name: dashboard_update
tools.description:
Patch one or more fields of an existing dashboard (by slug). Only the
fields you pass are changed; the rest are left as-is. Regenerates index.html
+ daas.md after the update. Returns the updated row or `{"error": ...}`.

tools.name: dashboard_delete
tools.description:
Delete a dashboard row by slug and regenerate index.html + daas.md. The
HTML file itself is NOT removed (only the registry row). Returns
`{"deleted": slug}` or `{"error": ...}`.

tools.name: gateway_list_data_mcps
tools.description:
List the data-fetch MCP upstreams gateway-mcp can route to.

Each entry is a row from the `gateway_upstreams` table (name, transport,
enabled, description). Disabled upstreams are hidden unless
`include_disabled=True`.

tools.name: gateway_list_data_mcp_tools
tools.description:
List the tools exposed by a data-fetch MCP upstream (live).

Reuses the persistent client from the connection pool — the client stays
alive across calls and is only recreated when the upstream config changes.
Returns each tool's name + description (+ parameters when available).

tools.name: gateway_call_data_mcp
tools.description:
Call a tool on a data-fetch MCP upstream and return its result.

Connects to the named upstream via the persistent client pool, invokes
the named tool with the JSON-deserialized `arguments`, and returns the
upstream's result. The client stays alive across calls and is only
recreated when the upstream config changes.

tools.name: gateway_add_data_mcp
tools.description: Add or update a data-fetch MCP upstream (idempotent upsert by name).

tools.name: gateway_remove_data_mcp
tools.description: Remove a data-fetch MCP upstream from the registry.

tools.name: gateway_get_data_mcp
tools.description: Get one data-fetch MCP upstream's full launch config.

tools.name: gateway_gateway_health
tools.description:
Health-probe each enabled gateway upstream and auto-flip transport.

For each enabled upstream in ``gateway_upstreams``:

- **http** transport: ping the row's ``url``. On failure AND the row
  carries a stdio ``command``, flip ``transport`` to ``stdio`` (degraded
  mode — mirrors the client-pool fallback so the next ``get_client()``
  launches the subprocess). On success, no change.
- **stdio** transport with a ``url`` set (i.e. it was flipped from http by
  a prior fallback): ping the ``url``. On success flip ``transport`` back
  to ``http`` (recovered). On failure, leave as stdio.
- **stdio**-only (no ``url``): skipped (nothing to probe).

Returns a per-upstream status report. Never raises — network errors are
captured as degraded states so the probe is safe to call from selfcheck.

tools.name: research_create
tools.description:
Create a persisted research bundle. Named collections are attached by
name; with ``create_missing=True`` missing entity/indicator/pipeline
collections are created empty. A ``dashboard_slug`` must already exist
(the tool does not build dashboard HTML). ``component_refs`` is a JSON
object string: ``{"rules": [...], "scraw_tables": [...], "indicators": [...]}``.

tools.name: research_get
tools.description:
Return a research + resolved bundle (live counts, dashboard url,
pipeline status, dangling-component warnings).

tools.name: research_list
tools.description:
List every research (optionally filtered by status) with attached
component names.

tools.name: research_update
tools.description:
Partially update a research. ``None`` means leave a field unchanged;
to detach a named component use ``remove_component``. Any newly-set
component name is validated to exist. ``component_refs`` (JSON string)
replaces the auxiliary refs.

tools.name: research_delete
tools.description:
Delete a research. Removes the on-disk report file. With
``remove_pipeline=True`` (default) deletes the owned pipeline collection
+ orphaned cron schedules/tasks. With ``remove_dashboard=True`` (default
False) deletes the referenced dashboard via the sibling tool. Shared
entity/indicator collections, rules, scraw tables, and observations are
NEVER deleted.

tools.name: research_generate_report
tools.description:
Assemble a markdown report from the bundle's live components, persist it
into ``report_md`` and write it to ``researches/<name>.md`` (dir from
``RESEARCH_DIR``, default repo-root ``researches/``). Regeneration
overwrites both. Returns ``{name, report_path, char_count}``.

tools.name: research_refresh
tools.description:
Re-run the research's data pipeline: recompute each indicator in the
indicator collection (via ``daas_run_indicator``), sync rule-based
collections (via ``daas_sync_entity_collection``/``daas_sync_indicator_collection``),
and report each pipeline item's current status. Returns a per-component
status report; per-item errors are reported, not raised.

tools.name: research_add_component
tools.description:
Attach an existing component to a research by name. ``component_type`` ∈
entity_collection | indicator_collection | dashboard | pipeline | rule |
scraw_table | indicator. The underlying object is not created - it must
already exist (for the named kinds).

tools.name: research_remove_component
tools.description:
Detach a component from a research. The underlying object is NOT
deleted. For named kinds, clears the research column; for auxiliary refs,
removes the name from ``component_refs``.

tools.name: workflow_register
tools.description:
Register a new workflow manifest (YAML). Version bumps on name collision
unless the manifest declares its own ``version``.

tools.name: workflow_get
tools.description: Get a workflow by name (latest version by default).

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: List every workflow (name, version, description, enabled, step_count).

tools.name: workflow_update
tools.description:
Patch a workflow. Only provided fields change. ``version`` defaults to
the latest version of ``name``.

tools.name: workflow_delete
tools.description:
Delete a workflow. Omit ``version`` to delete every version of ``name``.
Steps/runs cascade via FK.

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description:
Run a workflow manifest. ``params_json`` merges over the manifest's
declared ``params``. Returns run id + status; a paused run carries a
``resume_token`` for ``resume``.

tools.name: workflow_inspect
tools.description: Validate a stored manifest and return its parsed step plan (no execution).

tools.name: workflow_resume
tools.description: Resume a paused run. ``approved=False`` marks it failed.

canonical.brief: finddata 中央库健康巡检配置(总闸/限流)只读 MCP — fd_open_data.public.health_config

zh-CN.name: 健康巡检配置

zh-CN.whenToUse: 核对巡检是否开启、限流阈值是多少时。

en.summary: Read the central health-check master switch and rate-limit configuration; read-only.
en.whenToUse: To confirm whether checks are enabled and what the rate limits are.

es.name: Configuración de salud
es.summary: Lectura del interruptor principal de comprobaciones y de los límites de tasa; solo lectura.
es.whenToUse: Para confirmar si las comprobaciones están activas y cuáles son los límites.

fr.name: Configuration de santé
fr.summary: Lecture de l'interrupteur principal des contrôles de santé et des limites de débit ; lecture seule.
fr.whenToUse: Pour vérifier si les contrôles sont actifs et quelles sont les limites.

ja.name: ヘルス設定
ja.summary: 中央のヘルスチェックの主スイッチとレート制限設定を読み取ります。読み取り専用です。
ja.whenToUse: チェックの有効性やレート制限の値を確認するとき。

materials.whenToUse: 核对巡检是否开启、限流阈值是多少时。

tools.description: 读取 finddata 中央库健康巡检配置（fd_open_data.public.health_config 全量键值）：master_switch（总闸，false=纯巡检不出修复单）、max_daily_tickets（每日工单上限）、lookback_hours、thresholds、excluded_sources、expected_period_overrides；updated_at 为最近变更时间。

canonical.brief: 识律法律检索 MCP（lex-platform-v1）：法条检索与条级引用解析（law_db 全目录 + Qdrant law_chunks_v2 语义检索）、类案检索（wenshu_db 裁判文书，RustFS zstd 块正文）、指导案例检索、五源法律语料——每个结果携带 provenance 三件套（source/stable_id/as_of），未命中如实返回。识律平台 lex.finddatatech.cloud 对外数据入口，行/次双单位计量。

zh-CN.name: 法律检索
zh-CN.summary: 法规、案例与指导案例的检索与读取，附文书库检索入口。
zh-CN.whenToUse: 找法条、找类案或查裁判观点时。

en.name: Legal search
en.summary: Search and read statutes, cases, and guiding cases, with an entry to the judgment corpus.
en.whenToUse: When locating a statute, similar cases, or a judicial view.

es.name: Búsqueda jurídica
es.summary: Búsqueda y lectura de normativa, casos y casos guía, con acceso al corpus de sentencias.
es.whenToUse: Para localizar una norma, casos similares o un criterio judicial.

fr.name: Recherche juridique
fr.summary: Recherche et lecture de textes légaux, d'affaires et d'affaires de référence, avec accès au corpus de jugements.
fr.whenToUse: Pour trouver un texte, des affaires similaires ou une position judiciaire.

ja.name: 法令検索
ja.summary: 法令・判例・指導性案例の検索と読解に加え、判決文コーパスへの入口を提供します。
ja.whenToUse: 条文、類似判例、裁判所の判断を探すとき。

materials.whenToUse: 找法条、找类案或查裁判观点时。

tools.name: law_search
tools.description:
Search FindData law titles, ranked exact > prefix > contains.

法规库全目录检索（law_db.laws，含别名治理）；category 接受同义拼写。
结果逐条携带 provenance（source=law_db.laws, stable_id=law_id）。
与 business-mcp law_search 等价迁移（lex-platform-v1 task 7.1）。

tools.name: law_read
tools.description:
Read one law's metadata and text chunks by law_id.

返回法规详情与条级 chunk 结构，供正文阅读与条级引用使用。
与 business-mcp law_read 等价迁移（lex-platform-v1 task 7.1）。

条文按窗口返回：单次最多 ``limit`` 条（默认 200，上限 500），从
``offset`` 起算。整部法规一次全量回传会让大法典独占调用方上下文；
``total_chunks`` 与 ``next_offset`` 给出续读位置，分段拼接即全文。

tools.name: law_semantic_search
tools.description:
法条语义检索：Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 查询向量 -> Qdrant law_chunks_v2。

按语义相似度返回条级 chunk，逐条携带 provenance
（source=law_db.law_chunks_v2, stable_id=point id, as_of=导出日期）。
实现跟踪：lex-platform-v1 task 1.2。

tools.name: law_reference
tools.description:
条级引用解析：把「《民法典》第一百四十三条」类引用解析到法规目录条级定位。

无法解析时如实返回 not_found（含可读原因），绝不猜测。
实现跟踪：lex-platform-v1 task 1.2。

tools.name: wenshu_search
tools.description:
Search judgment titles (3,700万篇裁判文书), ranked exact > prefix > contains.

案号内嵌于标题（如「（2024）京01民初1号」），无需单独案号参数。
结果逐条携带 provenance（source=wenshu_db.judgments, stable_id=doc_id）。
与 business-mcp wenshu_search 等价迁移（lex-platform-v1 task 7.1）。

tools.name: wenshu_read
tools.description:
Read one judgment's full text (zstd blocks on RustFS).

正文按块解压读取；条目存在而正文缺失时如实标注，绝不编造正文。
与 business-mcp wenshu_read 等价迁移（lex-platform-v1 task 7.1）。

长正文按窗口返回：单次最多 ``max_chars`` 字符（默认 12000，上限 40000）。
超出时 ``content_truncated=true`` 且给 ``next_offset``——把它作为
``offset`` 再调一次即可续读，分段按字符切分，拼接后与原文逐字符一致。

tools.name: guide_cases_search
tools.description:
Search guiding-case titles, ranked exact > prefix > contains.

doc_type / reference_status 为封闭词表过滤（非法值如实拒绝）。
结果逐条携带 provenance（source=law_db.guide_cases, stable_id=case_id）。
与 business-mcp guide_cases_search 等价迁移（lex-platform-v1 task 7.1）。

tools.name: guide_cases_read
tools.description:
Read one guiding case's full structured sections by case_id.

与 business-mcp guide_cases_read 等价迁移（lex-platform-v1 task 7.1）。

tools.name: legal_docs_search
tools.description:
Search legal-document titles across the five corpora (47,256 篇).

Ranked exact > prefix > contains, case-insensitive. `source` is a closed
vocabulary of the five corpus codes — an unknown value is rejected with
`invalid_filter` plus the valid list, never silently matched to nothing.
`doc_type` is an equality filter. At most 200 rows.

Document bodies are never returned here; `has_content` says whether
`legal_docs_read` can serve one. Every hit carries provenance
(source=law_db.legal_documents, stable_id=doc_id, as_of=入库时间).

tools.name: legal_docs_read
tools.description:
Read one legal document by `doc_id`, body included only when fetched.

Returns full metadata (including `source_url` and the crawler `metadata`
jsonb minus its internal `object_keys`) plus `content_available`. When
the body never made it into the corpus the answer carries an honest
`note` and the `content` key is **absent** — not an empty string.
Unknown ids return `not_found`.

tools.name: get_account

tools.name: create_account

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: List open positions for an account with quantity, average cost, and P&L.

tools.name: search_instruments
tools.description: Search the tradable instrument universe by symbol or company name.

tools.name: get_bars
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV bars for a symbol, oldest-first.

tools.name: list_strategy_templates
tools.description:
List the built-in strategy templates with their parameter JSON Schemas.

Use these to build a template-track strategy spec:
{"kind": "template", "template": <id>, "symbol": "AAPL", "params": {...}}.

Returns:
    List of {id, name, description, params_schema}. Empty list on error.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Create a strategy from a spec.

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description:
Update a strategy. Changing the spec bumps its version; name/description
edits do not.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description:
List all strategies for the authenticated user.

Returns:
    List of strategies with id, name, spec, spec_summary, and version.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description: Get one strategy by id.

tools.name: run_backtest

Start a backtest of a strategy over a daily-bar window.

The backtest runs in the background; poll get_strategy_run(run_id) until
status is COMPLETED (stats + equity curve) or FAILED (error message).

tools.name: get_strategy_run
tools.description: Get a strategy run's status, stats, and equity curve.

tools.name: list_strategy_runs

tools.name: start_strategy

Start a live paper run of a strategy against a paper account.

Generate speech from text using TTS (registry method: tts).

Pass idempotency_key to make the call replay-safe: a second call with the
same key returns the existing asset (idempotent_replay=True) instead of
re-generating and re-billing.

tools.name: generate_video_submit

Submit an async video job; returns a job id in seconds (registry method: seedance).

Poll video_job_status until succeeded/failed. Client timeouts may safely
retry this call's sibling status tool — never resubmit.

tools.name: video_job_status
tools.description:
Poll one async video job by id (running/succeeded/failed/expired).

On success the returned payload carries asset_id and a signed download_url.

tools.name: models_voices
tools.description:
List available generation models and voices per provider (truth table).

Read before choosing a voice/model: shows capabilities (speed/captions
support), current status, and pricing notes per lane. The manifest at
generators/voices_manifest.json is the source of truth for this tool.

tools.name: voiceover_assemble
tools.description:
Assemble a long voiceover from a script plan (vaas-pipeline W2).

segments: ordered [{text, window_s?}]. Per-segment TTS with bounded retries;
over-window segments get edit suggestions (never tempo-hacked). Deterministic
plan slug; same plan + idempotency_key replays without re-billing.

tools.name: reference_clips_check
tools.description:
Review reference clips for every active voice; regenerate missing/recycled.

Run after upstream/model changes to produce a per-voice diff report.

tools.name: video_compose
tools.description:
Compose one video from a storyboard, deterministically (vaas-pipeline W3).

Every frame is recomputed from time t — same storyboard → same byte stream.
Scene kinds: html_intro/html_outro (inline seek-contract page), kenburns
(image list with slow pan/zoom), html_full (custom full-page HTML).

In hosted mode the response carries a fresh signed download_url so remote

tools.name: assets_stats

tools.name: assets_list_common

tools.name: assets_find_logo

tools.name: assets_list_compositions
tools.description: List registered Remotion compositions (id + duration).

tools.name: assets_validate_paths

tools.name: assets_get_scene_templates
tools.description: List scene template components from scenes*.tsx files.

tools.name: registry_list_generators
tools.description: List available generation methods, optionally filtered by asset type.

tools.name: registry_describe_generator

tools.description: Generate a brand-consistent cover image via Remotion (registry method: brand). (deprecated: Use generate_cover)
